topics.title: Basic ICT Concepts, Computer Hardware, Software, and System Threats

subtopics.content: ICT tools, information processing cycle, computer classification, system unit, peripherals, storage media, system vs application software, open source vs proprietary software, natural/human computer threats, user health hazards, and safety remedies
subtopics.objective: Explain ICT terms, tools, and socio-economic/educational impacts; distinguish data from information and classify computer types; categorize computer hardware (system unit, peripherals, storage media); differentiate system/application software and open source/proprietary software; identify computer threats (natural, malware, human damage), health hazards, and preventive remedies.

topics.title: Word Processing, Spreadsheet, and Presentation Packages

subtopics.content: Word processing uses/tools, editing, formatting, table/graphic insertion, spreadsheet formulas/functions, workbook management, presentation slide creation, master slides, slide shows, and delivery factors
subtopics.objective: Create, edit, format, and print word processing documents with inserted objects; master typing speed and accuracy (30-35 wpm); construct spreadsheet formulas and functions, manage workbooks, and format/print worksheets; create presentation slides, use master slides, format objects, and configure slide shows for delivery.

subtopics.content: Internet concepts, web browsers, Netiquette rules, email management, search engines, chatting, file downloading/uploading, and social media tools
subtopics.objective: Understand Internet concepts, navigation, browser features, and Netiquette rules; send and access emails; use search engines, chat platforms, social media, downloading, and uploading communication tools.
